race.comment: Keen to side with PLACENTIA BAY (3) in the last. Two runs back have been good, just finding one better at Bendigo first up in a stronger race before a solid fourth at Sale. Should be peaking now on his home deck and sets up to lead from the inside gate for Bates. KINGSFORD (4) ran well first up at this venue and should take plenty from that. He'll relish the rise in trip and draws well. JACKAND (9) is consistent and will be running on late, needs another win but should be in the mix. SEPHIA (14) will be fitter for recent racing and the lone career win came at this track. May be ready to show her best.
